physical_parameters: No numerical alpha, proton mass, QCD form factors, or cosmological coefficient is imported. All displayed momenta and regulators are in units of the benchmark mass.
UV_comparison: Subtract 3*log(lambda^2)/(16*pi^2), compare to analytically derived (3/2-6*log(2))/(16*pi^2); no finite sample is called the asymptotic limit.
parameter_path: The physical-QCD target is fixed renormalized MSbar g and quark masses at a reference scale; its finite matching counterterms are not calculated. The executed point-Dirac kernel is a different verification theory.
